# Cloudcell

Sandbox-as-a-service for AI agents. Linux jails (namespaces, cgroup, Landlock, seccomp) via AgentCell `sand`. No Docker.

Console: https://cloudcell.dev
API: https://api.cloudcell.dev
Help (HTML): https://cloudcell.dev/help
Also published at: https://cloudcell.dev/.well-known/llms.txt

## Docs (Markdown, no auth)

- [How to use](https://cloudcell.dev/docs/guide.md): get an API key from a human, then list/create/exec/delete. Errors, cwd, timeouts.
- [Changelog](https://cloudcell.dev/docs/changelog.md): what shipped

Prefer these `.md` files over scraping the HTML page.
